mapper.insert: insert into `problem`(title, description, input_desc, output_desc, sample_input, sample_output, difficulty, tags, contest_id, type, is_public, create_time) values (#{title}, #{description}, #{inputDesc}, #{outputDesc}, #{sampleInput}, #{sampleOutput}, #{difficulty}, #{tags}, #{contestId}, #{type}, #{isPublic}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: update `problem` set title = #{title}, description = #{description}, input_desc = #{inputDesc}, output_desc = #{outputDesc}, sample_input = #{sampleInput}, sample_output = #{sampleOutput}, difficulty = #{difficulty}, tags = #{tags}, contest_id = #{contestId}, type = #{type}, is_public = #{isPublic} where id = #{id}
